verdict.rationale: Featurebase has a dedicated API Reference tab covering the full HTTP and SDK reference, with per-endpoint pages (e.g., listing posts) and an llms.txt index. Nothing shows that the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in the browser, and no public OpenAPI spec was found that could power such tooling. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console, runnable examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
